result:
The decisive mistake was at Step 9. The Orchestrator took the Bing search results for "wheelchair accessible bars near..." at face value. It treated the list (12 Steps Down, Milkboy, Dirty Franks, Tir na nÓg, American Sardine Bar) as confirmed wheelchair-accessible bars near the museum, even though the results showed no accessibility information. Several of those bars are in Center City or Logan Square, far from the museum. The list also left out For Pete's Sake, which is near the museum. This framing sent the rest of the run toward distance checks on the wrong candidates. The final answer, 12 Steps Down, was wrong.

The Orchestrator's instruction at Step 10 then asked only for distances among those candidates and never asked WebSurfer to verify accessibility. The Orchestrator never corrected this at any later step.

AGENT: Orchestrator
STEP: 9
